segments.text: IEſus appered vnto the eleuen as they ſate at meate: & caſt in their teth their vnbelefe, & hardnes of heart, becauſe they beleued not them which had ſene that he was riſen again from the dead: & he ſayd vnto them: go ye into all the world, & preache the goſpel to all creatures: he that beleueth & is baptiſed, ſhall be ſaued. But he that beleueth not, ſhalbe damned. And theſe tokens ſhall folowe them that beleue. In my name they ſhall caſt out deuils, they ſhall ſpeake with newe tonges, they ſhall dryue away ſerpentes. And if they drinke any deadly thing it ſhall not hurte them. They ſhall laye their handes on the ſicke, and they ſhall recouer. So then when the Lord had ſpoken vnto thē: he was receiued into heauen, and is on the right hande of God. And they wente furth, and preached euery where: The Lord working with them, and confirming the worde with miracles folowing.
